name: NanoID Generator
summary: Generate compact URL-safe NanoIDs with adjustable length — cryptographically random.
description: Create one or many NanoIDs using the standard URL-safe alphabet and secure browser randomness. Default length is 21 characters; customize count and size for tokens, keys, and filenames.

faqs.question: How is this different from UUID?
faqs.answer: NanoIDs are shorter, URL-safe strings without hyphens. UUIDs are 128-bit standardized identifiers.

faqs.question: What alphabet is used?
faqs.answer: The default NanoID URL-safe set: A–Z, a–z, 0–9, underscore, and hyphen.

faqs.question: Is generation secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. IDs use crypto.getRandomValues in your browser — nothing is sent to a server.
